Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
1-3 yearsof experience or equivalent training.

Advises and counsels students, faculty, staff and the public, in person, by email, and by telephone. In accordance with various federal laws, Academic Senate regulations, and University and campus policies, reviews Statement of Legal Residence forms, registration materials, transcripts, quarterly course reports, and various forms and petitions. Provides information and serves as liaison regarding transcripts, verifications, registration and enrollment; Academic Senate policies, university policies, campus policies and procedures related to students’ academic records. Identifies potential problems, determines appropriate actions, and may refer to appropriate staff as needed. Independently responsible for the verification and distribution of online transcript requests for all UCI students, and alumni.
Organizational skills and ability to prioritize work and meet deadlines in an environment of frequent interruptions and distractions.
Working knowledge of policies, regulations, and practices with student records services and ability to analyze individual cases and made independent decisions based on this knowledge.
Ability to work with people from diverse cultures and socioeconomic backgrounds. Utilizes excellent constituent service skills with all interactions.
Working knowledge of University policies, processes, and procedures and of Federal and California laws pertaining to the privacy rights of students and access to student information.
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative relationships with campus departments and clients.

Familiarity with large scale registration, enrollment, and Student Information Systems such as ARIES, WebReg, WebSOC, WebAdmin, StudentAccess, SBS, web-based applications, email, and other enterprise software.
Ability to answer several incoming phone lines in a courteous and timely manner.
Knowledge of functions of campus offices.
Working knowledge of common University-specific computer application programs and productivity software and ability to enter information into various applications.
Knowledge of various machinery operations including laser printers, folding machines, and official date-stamps.
Written and verbal communication skills. Active listening skills. Customer service orientation. Interpersonal skills.
Ability to interact diplomatically and in using proper judgment while maintaining equanimity with individuals, including situations involving resistance and hostility.
